messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then slowly raises both hands to the sides of their head and tilts their head down, holding the pose before lowering their arms.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-full shot that slowly pushes in to a medium shot as the person moves.","clothing":"A light blue and white patterned cable-knit sweater, blue jeans, and brown lace-up shoes.","hair_color":"Deep red / maroon.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small topknot or bun at the crown.","identity":"A young person with a slim build and light brown skin, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or fairground at dusk, with a large covered structure lined with white lights, a red and yellow striped food cart, and a roller coaster track in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a neon-lit futuristic plaza to the reference fairground with a covered structure, string lights, striped food cart, and roller coaster track. The person's pose and action sequence were retained, and the lighting on the person shifted to warm dusk tones. The sweater appears less saturated and more blue/white than the source's pink-lit version, and the camera framing appears slightly tighter/cropped in the output.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the futuristic city scene with the reference amusement-park/fairground environment and its lighting, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and the existing camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the subtle change in sweater color is due to the new lighting or an unintended appearance change.
unexpected_changes: The person's clothing colors appear less saturated and more blue/white than in the source, beyond just the new scene lighting.
The output framing appears slightly tighter/cropped compared with the source.
